_meta.coordinates: Every position is [row, col]. row 0 = BOTTOM of the map, col 0 = LEFT (Arknights convention: tile at position(row,col) = tiles[ mapData.map[H-1-row][col] ], verified: route start/end land on tile_start/tile_end only with this convention). In this file stage.rows[i] is row i (rows[0] = bottom); stage.rowsTopDown is the same grid printed top-first for humans.
_meta.worldUnits: 1 tile = 1 unit. Enemy moveSpeed is tiles/second before level option moveMultiplier (0.5 in all these levels, i.e. effective speed = moveSpeed*0.5 tiles/s) [moveMultiplier semantics per Arknights engine].
_meta.layout: All stage maps are 19 rows x 21 cols and contain SEVERAL areas at once (camera switches between them): rows 9-12 = normal-round battlefield (cols 2-10 = LOCAL player board, cols 11-18 = mirror slot used to show the partner board, see player_map_lr_offset=8); row 7 cols 0-9 = local bench (10 hand slots, isValidHand=1); row 8 cols 4-8 = 5 non-bench hand tiles; rows 2-5 = boss/final-offensive battlefield shared by 2 players (left half cols 2-10, right half cols 10-18); row 0 = two benches for the boss area (cols 0-9 left player, 11-20 right player); rows 14-18 = enemy preview pen (configBlackBoard enemy_place_rect ((14,7),(18,13))) where next-round enemies are displayed during rest phase; rows 6 and 13 = hard separators. configBlackBoard regions (row,col corners): leftNormal ((6,0),(12,10)), rightNormal ((6,11),(12,20)), leftBoss ((0,0),(6,10)), rightBoss ((0,11),(6,20)).
_meta.normalBoard: Per player normal-round board = rows 9..12 x cols 2..10. Enemy spawns: (9,10) "lower red gate" and (12,10) "upper red gate"; protection objective E at (9,2). Rounds 1-3 only use (9,10). Col 9 (rows 9-12) is a non-deployable floor lane in every map; col 10 is the gate column. Deploy cap = 8 units (options.characterLimit=8).
_meta.bossBoard: Boss rounds (14 final offensive, 15 hidden core) use rows 1..5. Spawns/teleport-outs O at (2,10) and (5,10); ends E at (2,2) and (2,18); teleport-ins I at (1,3) and (1,17). Single-player variant (*_s levels) uses only the left half (routes end at (1,3)/(2,2)). Multi variant: routes cross BOTH halves: walk to one side telin (1,3) or (1,17), DISAPPEAR, wait 3s, APPEAR at (5,10), then cross the other half; i.e. the 2 paired players defend in series.
_meta.options: All stage+round levels: characterLimit 8, initialCost 0, maxCost 99, costIncreaseTime 1.0, moveMultiplier 0.5, steeringEnabled true. Stage-map maxLifePoint 15 / template maxLifePoint 150 are placeholders - real LP = band totalHp (20-45).

#.desc: void/decoration; not deployable; ground cannot enter; flyers may cross

r.desc: ground path; deployable by melee AND ranged (autochess rule: ranged may sit on melee tiles)

f.desc: walkable floor, not deployable (spawn lane col 9 / enemy preview area)

p.desc: floor with blackboard previewNotAlloed=1 (enemy-preview area row 16)

b.desc: fenced lowland: deployable (any), ground enemies cannot walk it (acts as wall for pathing)

a.desc: BENCH slot (isValidHand=1). Row 7 cols 0-9 = own bench (10 slots) in normal rounds; row 0 = benches in boss area

A.desc: hand tile WITHOUT isValidHand (row 8 cols 4-8 / row 1): not a bench slot [ASSUMED: temp/equipment staging display]

E.desc: protection objective (blue gate); leaking here costs LP

m.desc: swamp: every 3s a unit standing here gains 1 stack (atk speed -5, move speed -5%), max 10 stacks, cleared on leaving (trap_098_mire)

g.desc: exhaust grating: operators on it cannot be targeted by enemy ranged attacks

d.desc: deep water (trap_042_tidectrl skill 3): enemies take 40 dmg/s, attack speed -60, move speed x0.6; needs platform to deploy in act1 m05

i.desc: active originium: allies deployed on it and enemies crossing it take 70 true dmg/s, +20% ATK, +20 attack speed; lasts 300s

stageSelection.rule: At match start pick ONE stage map by weight among stages whose modes include the current modeId; the same terrain is used for every round of the match (normal area rows 9-12, boss area rows 1-5). Weights: m01..m04 (act1+act2) 50 each; act1 m05-m07 weight 0 (disabled this season). FUNNY (标准) and training always use act1autochess_m01.

roundLevelsNote: battleDataDict gives, per mode and round, the levelId (a WAVE TEMPLATE whose own mapData is a generic all-road grid and must be ignored; terrain comes from the chosen stage). Template enemy keys (enemy_1422_lrsldr etc.) are placeholders replaced at runtime, see 05-enemies.json generation. Multiple entries in one round = boss candidates (choose by bossInfoDict weight). *_s = single-player boss template, non-_s = multi (2 players share the boss board). Action fields: key, n=count, pre=preDelay seconds from fragment start, int=interval between spawns, route=index into routes. rg="local" marks boss parts spawned only on the local side. branches are spawned by skills/scripts (e.g. boss_summon_enemy for 假想敌：胄 drones, boss_escaped_walk/fly = enemies leaking from the partner side in boss rounds, boss_battle_multi_player = second boss copy on the partner side sharing HP, dragon = “炎佑” 9012_acloon).
